title: 7 Allego Alternatives for Sales Practice and AI Roleplay
summary: Compare 7 Allego alternatives for AI sales roleplay and practice, with best-fit labels, public pricing checked October 2026 and a two-week pilot scorecard.
body_markdown:
Tool


Best for


Main difference from Allego


Public pricing (checked October 2026)


Allego


Practice inside learning, content and coaching


Baseline: AI video avatar roleplay in a four-plan suite


Per user per month, billed annually; no figures ([pricing](https://www.allego.com/pricing/) )


Quotain


Practice built from a specific account and call


Practice-only scope; buyer built from your accounts and calls


Free trial up to 3 calls; Team plan quoted ([pricing](https://www.quotain.com/pricing) )


Hyperbound


Buying committees and demo practice with real-call scoring


Practice and real-call licenses, no content or LMS


Free plan; paid plans quoted per user ([pricing](https://www.hyperbound.ai/pricing) )


Second Nature


Video avatar practice with courses and certification


Roleplay-first, with courses built around practice


No price on the pages reviewed ([product](https://secondnature.ai/product/) )


PitchMonster


Several practice modes on seat contracts


Phone, avatar and screen-share; 12 month standard term


No price; two quote-based plans per seat ([pricing](https://www.pitchmonster.io/pricing) )


Outdoo


Multi-format practice next to an LMS you keep


40+ LMS integrations on Growth; not priced per seat


Free plan with 60 minutes of credits; paid plans quoted ([pricing](https://www.outdoo.ai/pricing) )


Mindtickle


Roleplay inside another enablement suite


Suite-for-suite swap


Depends on company size and team structure ([role play](https://www.mindtickle.com/platform/ai-sales-role-play/) )


Highspot


Teams that already run content in Highspot


AI Role Play built into Highspot


No price on the page; request pricing ([AI Role Play](https://www.highspot.com/product/ai-role-play/) )
